description: UCEclima links gauge screening, event-based hydrological calibration, a mass-conservative 2D local-inertial flood model and CMIP6 scenarios (NEX-GDDP-CMIP6, SSP5-8.5) with time of emergence in one traceable desktop project for Windows. Software described in a manuscript submitted to Environmental Modelling & Software (ENVSOFT-D-26-03951).
